name: cambench
title: Cambench
description: Every camera's specs, read through Firecrawl from B&H, the makers' own sites and press releases, DPReview, launch news, Wikipedia, MPB and eBay, standardized to one set of ~45 specs and verified across independent sources. Start a fetch, choose which cameras it covers and follow it as a workflow run. Raw pages stay in Outpost; the results publish to the site, which is where they are shown.
